Dear JB,

funny, I just stumbled over that last night. Ken Kellner has already a fix for it. You can download the latest version of unmarked from Github and that will make it work again.

devtools::install_github("rbchan/unmarked")

Best regards  --- Marc



From: unma...@googlegroups.com [unma...@googlegroups.com] on behalf of JB [JB19...@gmail.com]
Sent: 18 June 2020 13:20
To: unmarked
Subject: [unmarked] Error message when predicting from dynamic occupancy models

Hi,

I am playing around with dynamic occupancy models using the crossbill data. However, when I try to predict colonisation or extinction I get the following error message:

Error in .local(obj, coefficients, ...) : 
  ncol(coefficients) == length(obj@estimates) is not TRUE

I can't figure out what is causing this error message, so any help is greatly appreciated. 
Sample code below:

data(crossbill)
colnames(crossbill)
View(crossbill)
DATE<-as.matrix(crossbill[,32:58])
y.cross <-as.matrix(crossbill[,5:31])
y.cross[is.na(DATE) != is.na(y.cross)] <- NA

years <- as.character(1999:2007)
years
years <- matrix(years, nrow(crossbill.dat), 9, byrow = TRUE)

crossbill.umf <- unmarkedMultFrame(y=y.cross,
                                   siteCovs=crossbill.dat[,3:4],
                                   yearlySiteCovs=list(year = years),
                                   obsCovs =list(date=DATE),
                                   numPrimary = 9)
summary(crossbill.umf)
siteCovs(crossbill.umf)<-scale(siteCovs(crossbill.umf))
obsCovs(crossbill.umf)<-scale(obsCovs(crossbill.umf))

fm1 <- colext(~1, ~1, ~1, ~1, crossbill.umf)
summary(fm1)

fm2 <- colext(~1, ~year-1, ~year-1, ~year-1, crossbill.umf)
summary(fm2)

newdat <- data.frame(year=c("1999","2000","2001",
                            "2002","2003","2004",
                            "2005","2006", "2007"))
fm2.det <- predict(fm2, newdat, type='det', append = T)

newdat2 <- data.frame(year=c("1999","2000","2001",
                            "2002","2003","2004", 
                            "2005", "2006"))


fm2.col <- predict(fm2, newdat2, type='col', append = T)

fm2.ext <- predict(fm2, newdat2, type='ext', append = T)
